newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain ICO issues 18.5 bln pta 10-year bond.
newsitem.headline: Spain ICO issues 18.5 bln pta 10-year bond.

text.p: Spain's Official Credit Institute (ICO) said it would issue a 10-year 18.5 billion pesetas ($127.9 million) step-up callable domestic bond.
The statement added that bonds, maturing on March 14, 2002, will are be priced at par, with a pay date on March 14, 1997.
The step-up callable bond is paying a fixed increasing yield at the end of each of the first three years, during which ICO has the option to call back the debt.
